meaning:
ὀφειλή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ὀφείλω),
a debt: Mat.18:32; metaphorically, one's due: Rom.13:7, 1Co.7:3 (found also in π.; see Deiss., BS, 221; MM, xviii).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Then his lord called him in, and said to him, ‘You wicked servant! I forgave you all that debt, because you begged me.
Therefore give everyone what you owe: if you owe taxes, pay taxes; if customs, then customs; if respect, then respect; if honor, then honor.
Let the husband give his wife the affection owed her, and likewise also the wife her husband.
